title: Senior Backend Engineer

title: Operations & Admin Coordinator - UK hours
description:
Our client in the UK is looking for an Operations & Project Administrator to help them move the needle internally as they grow and mature as a technology services business.
This role is responsible for keeping the engine running: progressing internal projects, ensuring tickets always have a next step, managing escalations, improving how they work, and making sure nothing stalls.
You won’t be expected to be a technical engineer,but you will need to understand how an MSP works, how ticket systems operate, and how projects and support flow through a tech business. This is an outcome‑driven role, focused on momentum, clarity, and continuous improvement.
Key Responsibilities
Internal Operations & Delivery

• Own and progress internal projects that improve how we operate as a business.

• Act as an extension of the Project Manager / Operations function.

• Ensure work streams always have a clear next action, owner, and timeline.

• Identify blockers early and drive resolution.

Ticket & Workflow Management

• Oversee ticket queues and ensure tickets are actively progressing.

• Chase updates, escalate where required, and prevent stagnation.

• Ensure priority issues and uptime-related escalations are handled promptly.

• Maintain clarity between support work, project work, and internal initiatives.

Process & Continuous Improvement

• Identify inefficiencies in systems, workflows, and ways of working.

• Recommend and help implement improvements, automation, or simplification.

• Support documentation of processes so work is repeatable and scalable.

• Ask “how could this be done better, slicker or more efficiently?”.

Stakeholder Coordination

• Coordinate between technical staff, project managers, and leadership.

• Support communication around status, risks, and progress.

• Help bring structure and follow-through to internal initiatives.

Requirements

Essential

• Experience working in an MSP, IT services company, or similar tech environment.

• Strong understanding of how ticket systems, projects, and support teams operate.

• Highly organised with excellent follow‑through.

• Naturally proactive - sees what needs doing and gets on with it.

• Comfortable managing multiple moving parts.

• Outcome‑focused: cares more about progress than activity.

Desirable

• Experience with tools such as PSA/ticketing systems (e.g. Autotask, Halo, ServiceNow, Zendesk, Jira, Monday, etc.).

• Exposure to internal improvement projects or operational roles.

• Interest in automation, process optimisation, or systems thinking.

What This Role Is Not

• Not a technical engineer role.

• Not purely admin or note‑taking.

• Not reactive order‑taking.

This is a delivery and momentum role - someone who keeps things moving and improves the way the business runs.
Why This Role Matters
As we scale, internal friction becomes the biggest risk. This role exists to:

• Protect delivery quality.

• Keep standards high.

• Reduce noise and inefficiency.

• Help the leadership team focus on growth.

• You’ll have genuine impact on how the business operates day‑to‑day.

Ideal Personality Fit

• Driver over a passenger.

• Self-starter and highly motivated.

• Calm, structured, and dependable.

• Comfortable challenging “how we’ve always done it”.

• Enjoys bringing order to complexity.

• Takes pride in finishing things properly.

title: Strategic Finance, GTM & Revenue
description:
We believe that the way people interact with their finances will drastically improve in the next few years. We’re dedicated to empowering this transformation by building the tools and experiences that thousands of developers use to create their own products. Plaid powers the tools millions of people rely on to live a healthier financial life. We work with thousands of companies like Venmo, SoFi, several of the Fortune 500, and many of the largest banks to make it easy for people to connect their financial accounts to the apps and services they want to use. Plaid’s network covers 12,000 financial institutions across the US, Canada, UK and Europe. Founded in 2013, the company is headquartered in San Francisco with offices in New York, Seattle, Washington D.C., Raleigh, London, and Amsterdam.

About the team

- Plaid's Strategic Finance team plays a critical role in shaping our long-term business strategy and execution.

- The Strategic Finance team helps provide analytical rigor and data-driven insights to drive success across the entire organization.

- The Strategic Finance team's purpose is to support Plaid in achieving its short-term and long-term strategic & financial goals and help inform, articulate, and shape Plaid's growth trajectory.

About the role

You will own core pieces of Plaid's top-line revenue forecast and go beyond the number itself to understand what's actually driving it: internal data and external market factors that show how healthy and durable that growth is. You'll work day-to-day with our GTM organization, turning that analysis into insights they can act on. You are highly analytical and quantitative, comfortable building bottom-up from raw data as well as using Plaid's existing tools and dashboards to sanity-check the picture, and skilled at moving between complex modeling detail and the bigger picture it tells.

Responsibilities

- Own core pieces of Plaid's top-line revenue forecast, building and refining the models and processes that turn what's happening in the business into an accurate, forward-looking number.

- Go beyond the forecast itself to explain what's driving it: internal data and external market/macro factors that show how healthy and durable that growth is, while pushing the underlying process to be more automated and scalable over time.

- Partner day-to-day with our GTM organization, turning forecasting and analytics work into insights that shape their planning and decisions.

- Own recurring KPI and variance reporting cadences for key stakeholders (from day-to-day dashboards to quarterly Board materials), surfacing risks and opportunities early.

- Help recruit and grow a strong Strategic Finance team at Plaid.

Qualifications

- 4-6 years of experience in investment banking, private equity, management consulting, or FP&A/strategic finance, ideally including time at a high-growth technology company.

- Strong quantitative and analytical mindset, with the data fluency to work directly with large datasets (via SQL, AI tools, or both) and the judgment to build and validate financial models and workflows using them.

- Strong financial modeling, communication, and presentation skills.

- Comfortable working through moderately complex, ambiguous problems, distilling them into structured frameworks and actionable insights, with good judgment about when to loop in a manager or teammate rather than push forward alone.

- Demonstrated ability to build trusted cross-functional relationships and drive alignment on financial targets.

- Proficiency with core financial and GTM systems; Pigment, Tableau, or similar FP&A/BI tool experience is a plus.

Our mission at Plaid is to unlock financial freedom for everyone. To support that mission, we seek to build a diverse team of driven individuals who care deeply about making the financial ecosystem more equitable. title: Managed Services Consultant - Align
description:
Veeva Systems is a mission-driven organization and pioneer in industry cloud, helping life sciences companies bring therapies to patients faster. As one of the fastest-growing SaaS companies in history, we surpassed $3B in revenue in our last fiscal year with extensive growth potential ahead.
At the heart of Veeva are our values: Do the Right Thing, Customer Success, Employee Success, and Speed. We're not just any public company - we made history in 2021 by becoming a public benefit corporation (PBC), legally bound to balancing the interests of customers, employees, society, and investors.
As a Work Anywhere company, we support your flexibility to work from home or in the office, so you can thrive in your ideal environment.
Join us in transforming the life sciences industry, committed to making a positive impact on its customers, employees, and communities.
The Role
Looking for an opportunity to leverage your consulting expertise in a post-implementation capacity within the life sciences industry? Veeva Systems is seeking a Managed Services Consultant for our Align team. As a Managed Services Consultant, Align, you will be a key member of our Managed Services team, providing ongoing application administration and consulting support for customers live with Veeva Align. You will serve as a subject matter expert for Veeva Align, working remotely with multiple clients via phone and web meeting to support their territory alignments and related processes. This role requires a blend of product expertise, consulting acumen, and a passion for customer success in the life sciences industry. This is a remote, full-time, permanent role, supporting multiple clients in a shared, dedicated capacity.
This is a customer-facing role. Veeva Systems does not anticipate providing sponsorship for employment visa status (e.g., H-1B, OPT) for this employment position.
What You'll Do

Post-Go-Live Support & Managed Services:

• Provide ongoing consulting and expert administrative support for multiple Veeva Align clients.

• Lead quarterly territory alignment and targeting execution, including impact analysis, configuration, communication, and change management.

• Maintain accurate and up-to-date roster data and assignments for consumption by CRM and other downstream systems.

• Maintain large datasets related to territory alignment and roster management, ensuring data quality and managing upstream/downstream integrations.

• Consult on best practices and overall solutions tailored for each customer's unique Veeva Align requirements.

• Configure new Veeva Align functionalities and incorporate them into the customers' business processes.

• Create reports and dashboards.

• Triage, troubleshoot, and resolve client-reported issues.
General:

• Manage client interactions, set expectations, and provide clear, effective communication.

• Develop subject matter expertise on the Life Sciences industry and the Veeva solutions, particularly Veeva Align.

• Grow the capabilities of the team, develop best practices.

• Contribute to internal initiatives, knowledge sharing, and best practice development.

• Uphold the Veeva Vision and Values, including “Do the Right Thing” and “Customer Success”.

Requirements

• Bachelor's Degree or equivalent work experience required.

• Ability to work remotely and independently in support of multiple clients.

• Hands-on experience with data management and/or process analysis. Typically, very skilled with MS Excel for smaller data sets and MS Access or SQL for larger datasets.

• Ability to learn quickly and adapt to rapidly changing environments.

• Excellent verbal and written communication skills are essential as the position is client-facing.

• Fluent in English.

• Qualified candidates must be legally authorized to be employed in the United States. Veeva Systems does not anticipate providing sponsorship for employment visa status (e.g., H-1B or TN status) for this employment position.

Nice to Have

• Product knowledge

Remote, US based, Silicon Valley or Austin Preferred. 10-20% Travel required.

Here at PQShield we are at the forefront of Post-Quantum Cryptography that is changing how the world operates. We’ve helped shape all of the international PQC NIST standards, and we were the first cybersecurity company to develop quantum-safe cryptography on chips, in applications, and in the cloud.
We’re looking to grow our market penetration globally, and as such we are looking for an experienced Senior Sales Engineer (FAE) in North America. Working with a growing team in the US, you will be responsible for supporting sales through the technical integration of cryptography software and hardware into large manufacturers and enterprises. In this role, you will be a valued contributor to our global organisation by helping us understand the requirements of customers and be a trusted advisor both internally and externally.
We welcome candidates from two backgrounds:

• Experienced sales engineers: 5-8 years of sales engineering or FAE experience from a semiconductor, IP or security technology company.

• Engineers moving into sales: 5-8 years of hands-on engineering experience in embedded software, hardware design, semiconductor IP or security, and a genuine desire to move into a customer-facing sales role. We will invest in your sales training, and pair you with our Sales and Engineering leaders as you make the transition.

This role will expand on our world-class Engineering Team and is an exciting opportunity to experience a global growth journey. You’ll be working directly with Sales, Engineering & Management, as part of a constantly evolving Commercial Team.
⚒️ What you’ll be doing

• Supporting strategic accounts, identifying requirements, researching technical solutions, and presenting & demonstrating technical solutions.

• Following up with prospects to identify key customer requirements, providing appropriate levels of information at the right time for interested prospects.

• Educating prospects on PQShield ’s products and technology, including assisting with creating customer facing demos.

• Documenting technical communication with customers, creating Q&A documents, Statements of Work, quick start guides and similar

• Ensuring that the Engineering Team understands customer requirements and timelines.

• Collaborating with Sales and Marketing Team members on a strategic sales approach.

• Providing clear feedback from customers and prospects to the Management and Engineering Team to help evolve messaging and product positioning.

• Ensuring successful follow through of the sales cycle by maintaining accurate technical information using tools including Google Workspace, Hubspot, Jira, GitHub, etc.

EITHER

• Sales engineering track: 5-8 years of relevant FAE/sales engineering experience, with a history of success supporting sales cycles to large enterprises with complex technical requirements.

• Engineer-to-sales track: 5-8 years of engineering experience in embedded software, hardware, semiconductor IP or security, with direct exposure to customers (e.g. customer bring-up, integration support, design reviews, escalations) and a clear motivation to move into sales.

🎯 Required Skills And Qualifications

• Engineering Degree is desired for success in this role

• Experience with hardware IP cores, security software or embedded solutions to OEMs, defense contractors, semiconductor companies and/or security vendors .

• Experience supporting sales-cycles to large enterprises with complex technical requirements.

At Memtime, we deal with time - which means we also respect yours.
No endless meetings. No unnecessary bureaucracy.

Memtime is the leading software for automatic activity tracking:

•
All data stays on the user’s device. No monitoring. No surveillance. Full privacy.

• Customer-oriented mindset and practical problem-solving approach

• Team-player and clear communicator

• Experience with Serverless hosting (AWS Lambda, API Gateway, etc.)

• Experience as a team lead or mentoring engineers

You will be

• Improving internal and external APIs

• Defining architecture and implementation approaches for new integration features

You will be working with

• Node.js

• SQLite

• Serverless Framework

• AWS Lambda + API Gateway

• Our internal integrations marketplace & developer platform

Job details

• Fully remote - no relocation

• Full-time 40h / week

• Your choice of hardware

title: Security Operations Engineer
description:
Who We Are
Yellow Card is the largest licensed Stablecoin-based infrastructure provider operating across over 60 countries. From Stablecoin payment infrastructure to fiat settlement rails, wallet services, and custom local Stablecoin issuance, Yellow Card provides the complete infrastructure businesses need to manage Stablecoins, payments, and operations across 50 emerging markets.

The Security Operations Engineer is the operational backbone of the Security Operations Centre (SOC). It is a fully remote, hands-on, technical role that owns three tightly integrated domains: security alert design, triaging, and automated response; cloud security posture management across EKS and AWS environments; and posture tracking and reporting.
Reporting to the Associate Director, Product & Infrastructure Security, the engineer works alongside a mature Application Security team and collaborates closely with DevOps, Engineering, and Security GRC functions. The role sits within the First Line of Defense and is expected to progressively drive down manual effort through detection-as-code and SOAR automation.
This is not a perimeter-security or scan-and-report role. The right candidate must be comfortable writing detection logic, triaging cloud misconfigurations at the infrastructure level, and owning end-to-end vulnerability remediation cycles in containerised environments.
What You'll Do
1. Security Operations
The engineer owns the full lifecycle of security detection and response inside the SOC, from signal design through to automated containment. This is the primary domain of the role.
Alert design and coverage

• Design and maintain SIEM detection rules covering cloud, container, identity, and application layers, using both signature-based and behavioural logic

• Map detection coverage against the MITRE ATT&CK framework and identify gaps relevant to the organisation's AWS and EKS attack surface

• Integrate threat intelligence feeds to refresh rule logic for emerging threats and TTPs

• Maintain a detection backlog, prioritised by risk, with defined review cadences

Alert triage

• Daily SIEM alert triage following defined response timing standard

• Classify, investigate, and resolve security signals;

• Reduce false-positive rates through structured tuning cycles, with documented rationale for rule changes

• Maintain triage runbooks for key production detection rules

Automated response workflows (SOAR)

• Build and maintain SOAR playbooks for common alert types including IAM anomalies, misconfiguration alerts, exposed secrets, and container runtime events

• Automate enrichment steps (asset lookup, threat intel correlation, ownership resolution) to reduce analyst time-to-context

• Document automation logic and maintain version control for all playbooks

• Measure and report automation coverage rate as a standing KRI

2. Cloud Security Posture Management
Cloud posture management is the infrastructure-facing domain of the role, covering vulnerability management, identity governance, and configuration and change control. AWS EKS and Serverless resources are the primary environments.
Vulnerability management

• Own the end-to-end vulnerability triage process for cloud and container environments, prioritising findings by business impact using CVSS scoring, asset criticality, and exploitability context

• Manage EKS-specific vulnerability coverage: base image currency, workload scanning results, pod security standards compliance, and node group patching cadence

• Coordinate remediation with engineering teams by opening well-scoped tickets, tracking progress, and escalating SLA breaches

• Maintain MTTR and SLA compliance data by severity tier

• Oversee CSPM posture score targets; triage new Critical findi

title: Senior Software Engineer - Husky Storage
locationText: Boston, Massachusetts, USA; New York, New York, USA
description:
Husky is what we call the distributed, petabyte-scale columnar event store at the heart of our Event Platform, which powers dozens of Datadog’s most popular products - Logs, RUM, APM, Cloud Network Monitoring, Netflow, and many more. Husky was built from the ground up at Datadog to store and query massive volumes of event data at low cost, with data fully queryable within seconds of arrival.

 

As a Senior Software Engineer on this team, you'll work hands-on with a distributed storage system at petabyte scale, and help us evolve our platform to support the next level of scale that will power the AI era. We will move from a custom storage format towards open standards (Parquet, Arrow, DataFusion) enabling on prem solutions, increasingly complex analytical/batch workloads, and powering AI observability, sustainably into the future. You'll partner closely with Husky Ingestion, Metadata, and Platform, and increasingly with Lakehouse on the Iceberg-compatible boundary between Husky and analytical/batch workloads. You will also work with the open source community to  build the next generation of reusable software solutions that can be operated at scale.

 

Datadog has a culture that is increasingly rare in mature technology companies. We are an engineering driven, bottom up, high agency/high responsibility culture-where everyone is empowered and expected to drive the technological and strategic direction of the business over time. We are a blameless culture where we believe supporting each other through challenges produces the best outcomes over time and our track record corroborates this. We are open source champions. We believe in the flexibility of working remotely but also the value of bringing people together across our various offices worldwide-and our offices are nice places to work.

What You’ll Do: 

• Drive Husky to the next level of adoption by migrating our storage format to open source Parquet and re-imagine compaction on a format-agnostic, DataFusion-based substrate

• Drive concrete cost-reduction work: block-level inverted index compression, combining the database with external objects at the row level, and storage tiering/caching

• Scale our solution to enable customers to manage event versioning at scale, using temporal-database techniques.

• Play an influential role in operating and deciding how to best operate our service going forward.

• Work across the write path (with Ingestion) and toward a cleaner Iceberg-based handoff to ADP/Lakehouse for batch/analytical workloads

Who You Are: 

• Enthusiastic and experienced with large-scale distributed systems and/or storage engines

• Comfortable with improving and operating large distributed systems that customers rely on for critical business functions

• Strong fundamentals in columnar/file storage formats (Parquet, ORC, Arrow) or comparable systems

• Bonus : experience with Go, Java, or Rust; with compaction or compression/encoding schemes (RLE, dictionary, delta, gorilla); with object storage (S3/GCS/Azure Blob) at scale, including caching and cost optimization; with Kafka and stream processing; or with Kubernetes

 

Datadog values people from all walks of life. We understand not everyone will meet all the above qualifications on day one. That's okay. If you’re passionate about technology and want to grow your skills, we encourage you to apply. 

 

Benefits and Growth: 

• New hire stock equity (RSUs) and employee stock purchase plan (ESPP)

• Continuous professional development, product training, and career pathing

• Intradepartmental mentor and buddy program for in-house networking

• An inclusive company culture, ability to join our Community Guilds (Datadog employee resource groups)

• Free, global mental health benefits for employees and dependents age 6+

Benefits and Growth listed above may vary based on the country of your employment and the nature of your employment with Datadog.

title: Senior Product Designer
description:
About Us

We are customer-obsessed to an unusual degree. When we had a major network outage, everyone, including recruiters, engineers, and marketers, got on the phone with customers. That’s not a policy. It’s just who we are.

What keeps us going is what we hear from our Community. Families tell us they used to wake up every morning with a knot in their stomach. They don’t anymore. They tell us our product changed their relationship with their parents, from anxious and fearful to present and connected. It’s genuinely important work, and we don’t take it lightly.

If that’s the kind of problem you want to spend the next few years on, one with real scale, real mission, real momentum, and a real Community of people behind it, we’d love to talk.

Why this role exists

Communications for the aging in America are broken. Seniors are isolated. Their families are anxious in ways that go far beyond "I hope mom's alright." James Graham started this company after seeing his own grandmother get taken advantage of by the large telecom hegemony.

They are checking her bank account daily because they cannot tell if she is being scammed. They are calling three times a day because she did not pick up and they do not know if she is okay. They are lying awake wondering if she is connected to anyone, or just sitting alone. And at the most basic level, a lot of their phone service is completely unreliable or breaks entirely for the family once she reaches a certain age.

There are 55 million Americans over 65 living at home. Most of them, and most of their families, are navigating this alone.

Community Phone solves that. We built a phone so simple it works out of the box, no setup required. We wrapped it with AI-powered check-in calls that surface how she is really doing. And we built a family app integrated to Mom’s phone that replaces daily dread with genuine safety and peace of mind.

It is working. We are well into 8-figure subscription ARR, pacing to 9-figure, with 30,000+ families trusting us with something that matters deeply to them. Customers stay. They refer their friends. They tell us we took away an anxiety they had carried for years.

We are a lean, product-driven team. The people who thrive here take full ownership, are mission-driven, move quickly, hyper-curious, and care deeply about the customer. One of our product engineers won an Oscar for best foreign film, one team member is a Thiel Fellow, one is a Harvard Philosophy PhD dropout, others are the first growth hires at now-unicorn companies, others of our product engineers are former leaders of 60+ person engineering organizations, and many are former founders.

What you'll own

•
Set design strategy across the full customer journey - physical unboxing, mobile app, web dashboard, agentic ai voice check ins, etc - treating them as one coherent customer story end to end with clearly divided responsibilities, not surfaces competing for the same features or moments of customer attention throughout time.

•
Own outcomes past first activation. At this scale, getting someone through setup is only half the job - you'll be on the team accountable for adoption impact (AI check-in calls, call forwarding, spam blocking, call monitoring & safety features) and the metrics that show whether customers actually get value, in partnership with growth and PLG-focused teams. You are constantly learning post launch about how launched design can be improved.

•
Mock up full working prototypes: You should be completely fluent with modern AI development tools and be able to show full working mockups quickly. To the team. To customers in the ICP. To the CEO. You are AI optimistic and not AI psychotic.

•
Build the foundations a growing design org will need : a shared component language across app, dashboard, AI & sound interface, a research and testing habit (especially with lower-tech-literacy and senior users), and documentation that lets non-designers make good small decisions without you in the roo

title: Financial Controller

Financial Controller

Were looking for a hungry, ambitious finance leader ready to help shape the financial future of a fast-growing Group with businesses in advertising Solutions, e-commerce, retail and real estate.
This isn't a traditional corporate CFO role. It's a hands-on, build-from-the-ground-up opportunity where strategy and execution go hand in hand.

As CFO, youll work directly with the founders and leadership team to shape the Groups financial strategy and infrastructure.
This is a hands-on finance leadership role, where both strategic thinking and operational execution are essential.
Your responsibilities will include:

• Owning daily bookkeeping and financial recordkeeping to maintain accurate and reliable accounts

• Managing accounts payable, receivable, and financial reconciliations

• Building and maintaining financial models, forecasts, and budgeting frameworks

• Driving unit economics analysis across clients and revenue streams

• Leading cash flow management and financial planning in a high-growth environment

• Establishing financial processes that scale as the company grows

• Ensuring tax, regulatory, and compliance alignment with our Cyprus-based legal entity

• Acting as a strategic partner to leadership on growth decisions and capital allocation

Youll play a central role in translating operational performance into financial insight and strategy.
What Were Looking For
This role is ideal for someone who is an established CFO or ready to step up into a true CFO position earlier in their career, while still being comfortable owning the financial operations of a growing group.
You likely bring:

• 5-7 years of experience in finance, accounting, FP&A, or corporate finance

• Strong bookkeeping and accounting fundamentals

• Excellent financial modelling and analytical skills

• Exposure to tech, digital advertising, SaaS, or high-growth startups

• Understanding of revenue models, margins, and unit economics

• ACCA/ACA qualified (or equivalent)

• Knowledge on VAT & VIES reporting in the EU

• EU market experience, ideally with multiple companies

• The ability to operate in a fast-moving, sometimes ambiguous environment

• A mindset that combines ownership, precision, and strategic thinking

• Experience with scaling finance functions is a strong advantage.

• Advance experience working with Xero (software).

Why This Role Works Remotely
We operate as a remote-first team, working with talent across multiple countries while our legal entity and corporate structure are based in Cyprus.
This allows you to:

• Work fully remotely while contributing to a global business

• Operate within a stable EU framework

• Collaborate with an international team in a fast-moving industry

We care far more about capability, ownership, and impact than where you sit.
Why This Role Is Different
Many finance roles support growth.
This one helps design it.
You wont just inherit systems-youll build them.
You wont just report numbers-youll own them end-to-end.
For the right candidate, this is a chance to grow into the role of CFO while helping build a company at the same time.
Interested?
If this sounds like the kind of opportunity where you could do your best work, apply now.
Were excited to meet finance leaders who are ready to step up, take ownership, and grow with us.

description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. ABOUT THE JOB

Anduril’s Demand & Supply Planning team is seeking a world-class Demand & Supply Planner to join our team. The Demand & Supply Planner has an integral role at Anduril, having material flow responsibility throughout the entire value chain, from raw materials to finished goods shipped to customers. They will have full ownership of certain assemblies and product lines, and will be ultimately responsible for sending the correct signals to Purchasing and Manufacturing on what and when to buy or build. This hire will be instrumental in signaling and forecasting accurate demand, planning inventory levels, and ensuring that Anduril supports its hardware requirements via Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) software and other associated tools.

The right person for this role has demonstrate ownership and experience solving complex operational challenges with creative solutions in a fast-paced, resource-limited environment. This person will be flexible to provide support wherever needed to ensure products are built and shipped under stringent quality standards. If you are someone who thrives in such an environment, then this role is for you!

WHAT YOU'LL DO

• Manage day-to-day demand signaling, ordering, and inventory for various product lines.

• Identify and resolve supply issues by collaborating with Engineering, Purchasing, and Manufacturing teams.

• Lead Sales and Operations Planning (S&OP) discussions for Supply Planning on designated product lines.

• Work with Business Development and Growth teams to align forecasts with actual demand plans.

• Develop and maintain processes within MRP systems and associated master data.

• Drive strategic initiatives towards best practices, including demand shaping, advanced modeling, and inventory optimization.

• Bachelor’s degree in a technical field (i.e. manufacturing, engineering, analytics, computer science, etc.) or business field (i.e. finance, economics, supply chain management, business administration, marketing, etc.)

• 3+ years of experience in a supply chain or production role within a fast-paced manufacturing environment dealing with complex assemblies.

• Complete ownership of a complex value chain, coordinating between multiple, high volume of departments and teams to ensure on-time deliveries and adherence to quality standards.

• Technical expertise including ability to read technical documentation and understanding hardware manufacturing processes.

• Experience with ERP systems such as Oracle, NetSuite, and CRM systems like Salesforce.

• Ability to travel up to 10% of the time.

• Ability to relocate, if not already local to be onsite in Costa Mesa, CA.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

• Master’s degree or other higher education.

• Strong experience with SQL databases, including building custom queries for production and inventory metrics.

• Proficiency in data analysis and reporting tools such as Tableau, Power BI, or Qlikview.

• Knowledge of supply chain planning systems like Blue Yonder and best practices in demand planning, inventory management, and S&OP.

ABOUT SUPABASE

Supabase is the Postgres development platform, built by developers for developers. We provide a complete backend solution including Database, Auth, Storage, Edge Functions, Realtime, and Vector Search. All services are deeply integrated and designed for growth.

ABOUT THE ROLE

We’re looking for a Data API Engineer to join our Data API Team and help improve the feature set, reliability and performance of our Data API, based on the PostgREST project.

This role is ideal for someone who thrives in async, fast-paced environments and is excited about building developer tools that scale to millions.

WHAT YOU’LL BE RESPONSIBLE FOR

- Work on PostgREST’s PostgreSQL driver (based on Hasql) and remove bottlenecks and improve it’s performance.

- Work on PostgREST development of new features and bug fixes, aligned towards the goal of a multitenant Data API.

- Resolve incidents and escalated support issues, while also improving observability and performance.

- Collaborate cross-functionally with other teams to debug and solve integration issues with the Supabase platform.

YOU MIGHT BE A GOOD FIT IF YOU

- Strong Haskell skills with at least 3 years of experience.

- Experience using the C language.

- Solid knowledge of SQL and plpgsql scripting in PostgreSQL.

- Strong track record of contributing to and engaging with open-source projects. Bonus points if you’ve maintained an open source project.

- Strong experience with providing technical support to users with varying levels of technical expertise.

- Experience with debugging applications under the Linux operating system.

WHAT WE OFFER

- Fully Remote

We hire globally. We believe you can do your best work from anywhere. There are no Supabase offices, but we provide a WeWork membership or co-working allowance you can use anywhere in the world.

- ESOP

Every team member receives ESOP (equity ownership) in the company. We want everyone to share in the upside of what we’re building together.

- Tech Allowance

Use this budget to set up your ideal work environment-laptop, monitor, headphones, or whatever helps you do your best work.

- Health Benefits

Supabase covers 100% of health insurance for employees and 80% for dependents, wherever you are. Your wellbeing and your family’s health are important to us.

- Annual Off-Sites

Once a year, the entire company gathers in a new city for a week of connection, collaboration, and fun. It’s a highlight of our year.

- Flexible Work

We operate asynchronously and trust you to manage your own time. You know what needs to be done and when.

- Professional Development

Every team member receives an annual education allowance to spend on learning-courses, books, conferences, or anything that supports your growth.

ABOUT THE TEAM

Supabase was born-remote and open-source-first. We believe our globally distributed team is our secret weapon in building tools developers love.

- ~400 team members

- 60+ countries

- 20+ languages spoken

- Over $1B raised (including our $500M Series F)

- 540,000+ community members

We move fast, build in public, and use what we ship. If it’s in your project, we probably use it in ours too. We believe deeply in the open-source ecosystem and strive to support-not replace-existing tools and communities.

title: Senior Product Manager, Access Management
description:
Who We Are

Verkada is transforming how organizations protect their people and places with an integrated, privacy-sensitive AI-powered platform that includes solutions for video security, access control, air quality sensors, alarms, intercoms, and visitor management. 

We’ve got serious momentum in the market: more than 30,000 customers (including 100+ of the Fortune 500), a $5.8B valuation , more than $1 billion in annualized bookings, and backing from CapitalG, Sequoia Capital, General Catalyst, Felicis Ventures, Next47 and more. Physical AI is one of the most consequential technology shifts of our time, and Verkada is at the center of it.

You can look at all kinds of communities to see our platform’s impact in the world. It's the retailer that uses our agentic AI to deter theft before it happens. The warehouse that uses AI-powered alerts to make sure its team is protected on the floor with proper PPE. The school that’s alerted to a threat in real-time and triggers a lockdown in seconds, not minutes. We’re rapidly scaling this impact: today, more than 2 million Verkada devices are deployed across 170+ countries. 

The Opportunity

Every day, a security administrator somewhere decides who can open which door. A new nurse starts on Monday and needs the medication room but not the server closet. A contractor needs the loading dock for three weeks. Someone leaves the company at 5pm and their badge should stop working at 5:01. Multiply that by 200,000 employees across 400 sites, and you have one of the largest and least-solved logistical problems in enterprise software.

Access control is Verkada's second largest business: hundreds of millions of dollars in sales, growing 40 to 60% year over year, with roughly 80 people building in this area. Access management is the pillar that decides whether all of that feels effortless or exhausting.

We are hiring a Lead Product Manager to own it end to end: users, identities, groups, policies, requests, access levels, and visitor access, from the moment an admin expresses intent to the moment a door opens for the right person.

We do this well today. We think it can be dramatically better, through interfaces that make scale feel simple, APIs and integrations that let the system run itself, and agents that let an admin state what they want instead of clicking through configuration. You will own that as a vertical slice: web and mobile, the backend behind them, the configuration we push to door hardware, and the API and agent surfaces we expose. You will work with a dedicated designer, an engineering manager, and a dedicated engineering team.

We are committed to a thriving in-office culture. This role requires you to work onsite at our HQ in San Mateo, CA.

The access model and administrator interfaces: get the core concepts right

• Own users, groups, credentials, access levels, door associations, and schedules. This is the conceptual core of the product, and getting it right is the difference between an admin who trusts the system and one who works around it

• Own the administrative interfaces and experience across web and mobile: bulk operations, search, and review flows that stay fast when a customer has 200,000 users and 10,000 doors

• Own visitor access, including how guests are invited, credentialed, and expired

Provisioning and integrations: let the system run itself

• Own the API and integration surface. Most large customers want access to follow their identity provider and HR system automatically, so joiners, movers, and leavers are handled without anyone touching our UI

• Partner with Verkada's Core team to drive identity integration: SCIM provisioning, SSO, directory sync, and the mapping between an HR record and what a door actually does

Agents and natural language: let admins state intent

• Define how agents fit into access management. An admin should be able to say what they want and have the system propose the configuration that satisfies it

title: Sr. Staff Product Manager, AI-Native IT Service Management
description:
About the team
Service Operations is where enterprises find out whether their technology actually works. An outage starts, someone gets paged, a bridge call spins up, and the first twenty minutes go to working out what broke rather than fixing it.
Our team owns the products that close that gap: incident and major incident, problem and root cause, change, on-call, and Notify. The people using them go well beyond the service desk, from application, platform, infrastructure, and network teams to DevOps and SRE groups who get alerted around the clock and the major incident commanders pulling everyone onto one call. Thousands of the largest IT organizations run their operations on these products. We are rebuilding them AI-native, not AI-assisted, with agents that triage, correlate, and resolve, and with people moving from doing the work to directing it. Our goal is Zero Service Outage.
About the role
You will own a piece of that portfolio outright: what good looks like for it, who it is for, and whether we are honestly there yet. Zero Service Outage is the goal, and the work is making it true for the customers who run their operations on these products every day.
The interesting part of this job is not the model. It is the environment it runs in. Service operations data is the messiest data in the enterprise: half-populated CMDBs, incident descriptions written in a hurry at 2am, alert noise from a dozen monitoring tools, and naming conventions that differ by region. An agent that triages perfectly against a clean eval set can behave very differently against a real customer’s incident stream, for reasons that have nothing to do with reasoning ability. Understanding why, and designing for it, is the job.
We also carry an installed base. Customers run today’s experience in production, and moving them onto an AI-native one is not a UI refresh. It is a change to how their IT team works, who approves what, and what an operator trusts an agent to do unsupervised. You will be making calls about what we carry forward, what we leave behind, and what we have to earn the right to automate.
How we work is changing as fast as what we build. Prototype instead of describing the idea. Put a working demo in front of people instead of a slide about a demo. Draft the spec, stand up a rough eval harness, pull your own data. ServiceNow invests in state-of-the-art tooling and expects you to use it. Product managers are better positioned than anyone to lead that shift, and part of this role is pulling the team around you into it.
What you get to do in this role

• Own an AI-native ITSM product end to end, from the customer problem through launch criteria to how it performs in production.

• Set product strategy for the Service Operations portfolio that supports ServiceNow ’s growth toward $10B+ in revenue.

• Build, not just specify. Prototype the interaction, stand up the eval harness, and get into the agent execution logs to understand what happened on the runs that failed.

• Define what good means for an autonomous agent in an operational context where the cost of a wrong action is a second outage. Hold the line on it with engineering and have the honest conversation about what we can defensibly promise.

• Work with design partners across the teams that run on this: service desk, application and infrastructure support, DevOps and SRE, and major incident command. Build in their environment against their real incidents, changes, and RCAs, then turn what you learn into something that generalizes to the next thousand customers.

• Own your outcome metrics, such as time to resolve, change failure rate, and repeat incidents, in partnership with Customer Success, and make sure the instrumentation exists to show whether what you shipped moved them.

• Align with peer product managers so the team is working on the right things at the right time and guide multiple teams through ambiguous product development without losing sight of the unified vision.

LabXchange is a nonprofit education project based at Harvard University. Too many students, whether because of economic or geographic limitations, lack access to high-quality science education and the chance to engage meaningfully in the scientific process. Globally, this has led to significant gaps in diversity across scientific fields and in scientific literacy overall. LabXchange believes students everywhere should have an equal opportunity to prepare for and succeed in science.
To make that real, LabXchange offers the best of digital science education to teachers and students around the world, for free, through an advanced, flexible and interactive learning platform. It goes well beyond text, video and multiple-choice questions, with virtual lab simulations, interactive animations, experimental design simulations and a knowledge graph that can be remixed into customised learning pathways. • Bring in the user's voice through interviews, surveys and usability testing with students and educators around the world.

QA Engineer - Wearables, Mobile & Cloud

Remote, United States | Austin preferred | $130,000-$155,000 annual base

Own quality from the wrist to the cloud. Join a lean health-technology team building a wearable platform that turns continuous biometric signals into data researchers, health systems, and enterprise partners can trust.

This is a hands-on role with real influence over what ships. You will trace failures across devices, mobile SDKs, APIs, and cloud services; build automation; fix bugs where you can; and lead the push to make every release more reliable.

What You’ll Own

• Test the full journey: wearable firmware, Bluetooth pairing and sync, iOS and Android SDKs, cloud processing, APIs, and the app.

What You Bring

• Substantial QA or test-engineering experience, typically 5+ years, including at least two years owning quality at a startup shipping hardware and software.

• Hands-on Bluetooth/BLE and mobile-device testing, with clear examples of releases you owned and reliability you improved.

• Coding in Python or JavaScript/TypeScript; the ability to read and fix Swift, Kotlin, or Go; and experience building automated test suites.

• Exposure to native mobile and cloud systems. The environment includes Go, Swift, Kotlin, AWS/S3, Firebase Crashlytics, and Mixpanel. You do not need to be an expert in every tool.

• Practical use of AI coding or testing tools, with a clear approach to checking their output.

• A sustained, explainable work history with clear personal ownership of shipped work.

Wearables, biometrics, health technology, IoT, firmware testing, and data-pipeline experience are especially relevant. Strong experience with other connected products is welcome.

Why Join

Take ownership across the entire product, shape the quality function, and make a visible difference to a platform people rely on every night. This player-coach role keeps you close to the code, the devices, and the decisions.

Compensation

$130,000-$155,000 annual base, plus equity and benefits. Final terms depend on experience, scope, and location.

Apply now and get a response within 24 hours.
